title: erigeron maximus var. palustris
intro: Erigeron maximus var. palustris, commonly known as Marsh Fleabane, is a perennial plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Fleabane are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which have antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Fleabane, such as erigeronin and erigeronol, have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antiviral activities, contributing to its therapeutic potential.
